_comments.kiRegenBonus: Extra Ki regeneration ratio. 0.25 = +25% regen, so 10 Ki/s becomes 12.5 Ki/s.
_comments.androidUpgradedKiRegenBonusMultiplier: Multiplier applied to kiRegenBonus when Android Upgraded is active. 2.0 makes the default +25% become +50%.
_comments.fullKiPowerBoost: Multiplicative stat boost while at or above the full Ki threshold. 0.20 = +20%.
_comments.androidUpgradedFullKiPowerBoostMultiplie: Multiplier applied to fullKiPowerBoost when Android Upgraded is active. 0.5 makes the default +20% become +10%.
_comments.fullKiThreshold: Current Ki ratio required for the stat boost. 0.85 = 85% Ki or higher.
_comments.boostedStats: DMZ stats boosted by Ki Boosting Body while the threshold is met. RES is interpreted as DEF only for this passive.
